maddeler.e:
استقبحوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْبَحُوا (istaqbaḥū) /is.taq.ba.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اُسْتُقْبِحُوا (ustuqbiḥū) /us.tuq.bi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# اِسْتَقْبِحُوا (istaqbiḥū) /is.taq.bi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
